Four Large-Sized Telescopes to be inaugurated at CTAO-North in La Palma
September 17, 2026
On 15 October 2026, the CTAO Large-Sized Telescope Collaboration will inaugurate the complete array of four LSTs at CTAO-North in La Palma, marking the completion of all Large-Sized Telescopes planned for the site. IFAEâs Gamma-ray Group has contributed to the project throughout its development, with roles spanning collaboration management, technical coordination, camera integration, telescope hardware and data-analysis software.

Prof. Mario MartÃ­nez named new Director of IFAE
September 7, 2026
Mario MartÃ­nez has been nominated as the new Director of IFAE by the instituteâs Governing Board. He will take office on November 1, 2026, succeeding Eugenio Coccia. An ICREA Research Professor at IFAE since 2004, Mario MartÃ­nez is currently Deputy Director, leads the instituteâs Gravitational Waves Group, and is Scientific Director of IFAEâs Severo Ochoa Centre of Excellence programme.

Highlight
LST-1 and MAGIC reveal new insights into the most distant very-high-energy blazar
September 2, 2026
Observations with the LST-1 and MAGIC telescopes have provided the most detailed study yet of OP 313, the most distant blazar ever detected at very high gamma-ray energies. The result follows its first very-high-energy detection by LST-1 in 2023, an effort in which the IFAE Gamma-ray Group was already involved. IFAE contributes to LST-1 and MAGIC through instrumentation, operation and data-analysis software.
